Approved evidence

GeneBench-Pro

benchmark.genebench

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Inspected GeneBench-Pro primary paper v2 and the exact immutable public-package card are distinguished. All bounded assertions have actual author, separate source-verifier and adversarial AI exact-digest source-content reviews. Reviewed/unreviewed and public/AA/internal partitions are not extra families. Source-reported results, historical expert roles, model-attempt/error conditions and paper/card licensing differences remain explicit. No code or payload replication, comprehensive upstream rights clearance, current supplier qualification or measured provider performance is implied. Other similarly named releases require explicit identity reconciliation; this metadata admission is not a frozen-core denominator decision.

full source

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

GeneBench-Pro · benchmark task: The paper’s synthetic DRX1 carrier-screening example requires three linked stages: reportable carrier calling, calibration of assay performance and risk assembly using residual carrier risk and the full partner roster.

assertion.genebench.pro.drx1-case-workflow.20261112

  • The five staged tables cover screening adults, potential partners, calibration controls, target metadata and assay observations; the partner estimand covers the whole roster rather than only tested partners.
